lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming a grid-like 2D spatial arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a grid of anchor nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges running longitudinally across the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadows on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible notch/irregularity on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A high-density concentration of small, high-luminance spots on the dorsal surface of the visible pectoral fin.
